title: Trump deletes Christ-like AI image. It's not first time he's used AI
body: President Donald Trump deleted an AI-generated image that appeared to depict him as Jesus from social media. It's not the first time he's used AI.

title: Stanford AI Index 2026: The Trust Gap Hits Critical Levels

title: Here's Why Alphabet Shares Popped Today (And Why Investors Have High Hopes for the Upcoming Results)
body: Shares in Google-owner Alphabet ( GOOG +3.26%) ( GOOGL +3.35%) rose by 3.3% by 12:30 pm today. The move comes after an analyst at a heavyweight company, Citi, placed the company on a "90-day catalyst watch" and raised the price target to $405 from a previous target of $390.

title: Riley Gaines responds after Trump dismisses criticism of AI Jesus post
